tabs.tab_title: How soon can my carport be built?
tabs.tab_content: Both advertised packages include construction within 7 days from check measure for eligible, site-ready projects. The timeframe depends on completion of any required approvals, satisfactory site and ground conditions, site access and confirmed installation scheduling. We confirm your actual timing during the quotation process.

tabs.tab_title: Do you supply and install attached and freestanding carports?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. We offer attached and freestanding aluminium carport configurations. We consider your available space, proposed connection points and intended use when discussing the design.

tabs.tab_title: Will my carport require council approval?
tabs.tab_content: That depends on the property, carport dimensions, location and applicable planning controls. Approval requirements must be checked for your proposed work; we can discuss the likely next steps during the quotation process.

tabs.tab_title: What does the $6,690 single-carport package include?
tabs.tab_content: The $6,690 starting price is for a 2.8m wide × 5.8m long × 2.7m high freestanding flat-roof carport. The advertised package includes installation into concrete footings, engineered aluminium beams, 110 × 110 mm engineered aluminium posts, genuine COLORBOND metal roofing, flashings and gutters, and supply and installation by licensed NSW builders. The final price is subject to your site conditions and any required additional work.

tabs.tab_title: Do you offer a double-carport package?
tabs.tab_content: Yes. Our freestanding double-carport package measures 5.5m wide × 5m long × 2.8m high. It includes the same advertised material and installation inclusions as the single-carport package. We will provide the double-carport price in a project-specific quotation.

tabs.tab_title: What materials are included in the carport packages?
tabs.tab_content: Both advertised packages include engineered aluminium beams, 110 × 110 mm engineered aluminium posts, genuine COLORBOND metal roofing, flashings and gutters, and installation into concrete footings. The specific roof configuration, colour selections and final project details are confirmed in the written quotation.
